messages.author: 7e4be9d29a222a0e
messages.subject: plot.mshape is missing
parts:
Hello,
I just tried to use plot.mshape from the latest version of geomorph, but it seems to be missing. 

Here's the code & error message:

> XX <- mshape(CAP23)
> plot.mshape(XX)
Error in plot.mshape(XX) : could not find function "plot.mshape"

I did run plot(XX), which produced the attached image. It's just what I wanted, but I don't know if it's what plot.mshape produces.

Dave Thulman

messages.author: aab55242ff4da6c6
messages.subject: Re: [geomorph-r-package] plot.mshape is missing
parts:
Dave,

As an S3 plot generic, the function is not a top level geomorph function. It is supposed to work just using plot(). The “mshape” class of the object informs R that plot = plot.mshape. You can use the function directly, as if to override the S3 generic designation with:

geomorph:::plot.mshape(XX)

The function is not missing, it is just an internal function that can only be called by a class match. 

Mike

Sent from my iPhone
